reviews.title: Fast, reliable SSD.
reviews.comment: Samsung 990 PPO SSDs are top quality.  Fast, reliable, easy to install and operate at lower temp even when running maxed out.  Highly recommend
reviews.author: BigBlock

reviews.title: Fast, Reliable, Samsung, i'm buying more
reviews.comment: one of the best values in fast nvme drives. almost 3 times faster than the old one it replaced. I've got 6 of them and never had one fail.
reviews.author: Are See

reviews.title: Were the best, now the competition is close enough to matter
reviews.comment: I have purchased Samsung Pro NVMEs for years starting with 960's and always paid the premium because of their warranty and I never had one fail. Now the landscape is changing and there are competitors that offer close to the same performance and similar warranties at lower costs. With that said, these are great drives, reliable but not good value for the money.
reviews.author: S. Smith

reviews.title: Flawless
reviews.comment: Great speed and quality for the price.  I have never had a failure with Samsung SSDs.
